correctness.rationale: At P0, X=0 has divisor (q+1)P0+P2, with P2 having a different tangent, proving unique dual branch. The local smooth curve x+t^(q+1)+x^(q+1)t=0 yields ord_t u=q and ord_t v=M=(q+1)²+1 for the Gauss map. For odd q, gcd(q,M)=1; cancellations cannot produce values below qM beyond monomial valuations, and the conductor of <q,M> is (q−1)(M−1)<qM, yielding exact semigroup, delta and conductor. Frobenius permutes the Tallini special tangent points, whereas coordinate points in Pellikaan model are rational. Independent q=3,5,7,9 formal-series and gap checks corroborate, without replacing uniform proof.

originality.rationale: Published plane-filling Tallini/Pellikaan geometry includes the original curve, its Weierstrass semigroups and special tangent contacts.
